objective.evidence: One complete luxury eau-de-parfum bottle is visible: rectangular honey-amber faceted glass body, golden liquid, heavy crystal cap, brass neck and an ivory organza ribbon. No extra object or plinth.

text_facts.evidence: No text or factual labels are required. No readable writing, label or watermark is visible.

composition.evidence: The bottle and ribbon are fully visible but do not fit the requested central 80% with at least 10% margin on every side. Visual inspection of both composites shows the ribbon too near the right edge and the cap/base too near the vertical edges. Read-only alpha >64 bounding box is (297,121,1060,1246) on 1145x1374: top 8.81%, right 7.42%, bottom 9.32%, left 25.94%. These visible-object margins already fail without counting faint alpha outside the silhouette.

brand_reference.evidence: Compared with the official reference, the candidate reproduces the essential premium material vocabulary: clear faceted crystal, honey-gold fragrance, softly rounded rectangular bottle, brushed brass neck and fine sheer ivory ribbon. The different ribbon curl and bottle proportions are compatible with a fresh prompt-only generation; pixel identity is not required.

visual_integrity.evidence: Cap facets, shoulders, heavy glass base and liquid refractions form coherent bottle geometry. The ribbon has fine woven texture, soft folds and a complete tapered tail; no conspicuous broken contour or malformed attachment is visible at the inspected resolution.

preservation.evidence: This is a fresh text-only generation. The official example is an evaluation reference, not an edit target or conditioning image.

transparency.evidence: Viewed original candidate plus white and dark composites, alongside the corresponding reference views. Background around the cap, bottle, ribbon and their intervening spaces is visually clean on both destinations, without a material broad halo, rectangular matte, painted checkerboard or cast shadow. Fine glass highlights and ribbon edges remain useful; this visual finding does not assert that every exterior pixel has exactly zero alpha.

prompt_improvement: For a future separately authorized attempt, place the entire bottle-and-ribbon group inside the central 70% of the canvas, with at least 15% empty margin around its outermost tips; center the combined group, not only the bottle, and keep the ribbon compact. Retain current glass, brass and organza material quality.
